annotations.description:
Annotations on the VMware Admin Cluster.
This field has the same restrictions as Kubernetes annotations.
The total size of all keys and values combined is limited to 256k.
Key can have 2 segments: prefix (optional) and name (required),
separated by a slash (/).
Prefix must be a DNS subdomain.
Name must be 63 characters or less, begin and end with alphanumerics,
with dashes (-), underscores (_), dots (.), and alphanumerics between.


**Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the annotations present in your configuration.
Please refer to the field 'effective_annotations' for all of the annotations present on the resource.
annotations.rationale: annotations is not a security sensitive field

bootstrap_cluster_membership.description: The bootstrap cluster this VMware admin cluster belongs to.
bootstrap_cluster_membership.rationale: bootstrap_cluster_membership is not security sensitive enough

description.description: A human readable description of this VMware admin cluster.
description.rationale: description is not a security sensitive field

enable_advanced_cluster.description: If set, the advanced cluster feature is enabled.

image_type.description: The OS image type for the VMware admin cluster.
image_type.rationale: Selects the OS image type for the admin cluster. This is an operational OS choice with no single 'secure' option, so constraining it generically does not improve security and is not a policy target.

location.rationale: Determines the region/zone where the resource is created. Policy should restrict it to an approved-region whitelist for data residency; the allowed set is parameterised (a hardcoded example whitelist is acceptable).

name.description: The VMware admin cluster resource name.
name.rationale: name does not require security considerations

on_prem_version.description: The Anthos clusters on the VMware version for the admin cluster.
on_prem_version.rationale: on_prem_version is a sensitive field and should be protected

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: project is not a security sensitive field

addon_node.description: The VMware admin cluster addon node configuration.

addon_node.auto_resize_config.enabled.description: Whether to enable controle plane node auto resizing.

anti_affinity_groups.description:
AAGConfig specifies whether to spread VMware Admin Cluster nodes across at
least three physical hosts in the datacenter.

anti_affinity_groups.aag_config_disabled.description:
Spread nodes across at least three physical hosts (requires at least three
hosts).
Enabled by default.
anti_affinity_groups.aag_config_disabled.rationale: aag_config_disabled is not a security sensitive field

authorization.description: The VMware admin cluster authorization configuration.

authorization.viewer_users.description:
Users that will be granted the cluster-admin role on the cluster, providing
full access to the cluster.

authorization.viewer_users.username.description: The name of the user, e.g. 'my-gcp-id@gmail.com'.
authorization.viewer_users.username.rationale: Names a principal granted viewer access to the cluster. As an access-granting principal it is a valid policy target: enforce against public/wildcard principals so read access is never granted to allUsers/wildcards; the policy must not pin specific user identities.

auto_repair_config.enabled.rationale: enabled is not a security sensitive field

control_plane_node.description: The VMware admin cluster control plane node configuration.

control_plane_node.cpus.description: The number of vCPUs for the control-plane node of the admin cluster.
control_plane_node.cpus.rationale: cpus is not a security sensitive field

control_plane_node.memory.description: The number of mebibytes of memory for the control-plane node of the admin cluster.
control_plane_node.memory.rationale: memory is not a security sensitive field

control_plane_node.replicas.description: The number of control plane nodes for this VMware admin cluster.
control_plane_node.replicas.rationale: replicas is not a security sensitive field

load_balancer.description: Specifies the load balancer configuration for VMware admin cluster.

load_balancer.f5_config.description: Configuration for F5 Big IP typed load balancers.

load_balancer.f5_config.partition.description:
he preexisting partition to be used by the load balancer. T
his partition is usually created for the admin cluster for example:
'my-f5-admin-partition'.
load_balancer.f5_config.partition.rationale: partition is not security sensitive enough

load_balancer.f5_config.snat_pool.description: The pool name. Only necessary, if using SNAT.
load_balancer.f5_config.snat_pool.rationale: snat_pool does not require security considerations

load_balancer.manual_lb_config.addons_no.description: NodePort for add-ons server in the admin cluster.
load_balancer.manual_lb_config.addons_no.rationale: addons_node_port does not require security considerations

load_balancer.manual_lb_config.control_p.description:
NodePort for control plane service. The Kubernetes API server in the admin
cluster is implemented as a Service of type NodePort (ex. 30968).
load_balancer.manual_lb_config.control_p.rationale: control_plane_node_port is not security sensitive enough

load_balancer.manual_lb_config.ingress_h.description:
NodePort for ingress service's http. The ingress service in the admin
cluster is implemented as a Service of type NodePort (ex. 32527).
load_balancer.manual_lb_config.ingress_h.rationale: ingress_http_node_port is not security sensitive enough

load_balancer.manual_lb_config.ingress_h.description:
NodePort for ingress service's https. The ingress service in the admin
cluster is implemented as a Service of type NodePort (ex. 30139).
load_balancer.manual_lb_config.ingress_h.rationale: ingress_https_node_port is not security sensitive enough

load_balancer.manual_lb_config.konnectiv.description:
NodePort for konnectivity server service running as a sidecar in each
kube-apiserver pod (ex. 30564).
load_balancer.manual_lb_config.konnectiv.rationale: konnectivity_server_node_port is not security sensitive enough

load_balancer.vip_config.description: Specified the VMware Load Balancer Config

load_balancer.vip_config.addons_vip.description: The VIP to configure the load balancer for add-ons.
load_balancer.vip_config.addons_vip.rationale: addons_vip is not security sensitive enough

load_balancer.vip_config.control_plane_v.description:
The VIP which you previously set aside for the Kubernetes
API of this VMware Admin Cluster.
load_balancer.vip_config.control_plane_v.rationale: A virtual IP address the team sets aside for the Kubernetes API. It is an environment-specific network value; a generic platform policy cannot constrain it without hardcoding an IP, so it is not a useful policy target.

network_config.description: The VMware admin cluster network configuration.

network_config.pod_address_cidr_blocks.description:
All pods in the cluster are assigned an RFC1918 IPv4 address from these ranges.
Only a single range is supported. This field cannot be changed after creation.
network_config.pod_address_cidr_blocks.rationale: Defines the RFC1918 IP ranges allocated to pods. The ranges are an environment-specific internal-addressing choice; a generic policy cannot constrain them without hardcoding ranges, so it is not a useful policy target (consistent with the same field being false on the bare-metal clusters).

network_config.service_address_cidr_bloc.description:
All services in the cluster are assigned an RFC1918 IPv4 address
from these ranges. Only a single range is supported.. This field
cannot be changed after creation.
network_config.service_address_cidr_bloc.rationale: Defines the RFC1918 IP ranges allocated to services. The ranges are an environment-specific internal-addressing choice; a generic policy cannot constrain them without hardcoding ranges, so it is not a useful policy target (consistent with the same field being false on the bare-metal clusters).

network_config.vcenter_network.rationale: vcenter network name is not sensitive information

network_config.dhcp_ip_config.description: Configuration settings for a DHCP IP configuration.

network_config.dhcp_ip_config.enabled.description:
enabled is a flag to mark if DHCP IP allocation is
used for VMware admin clusters.

network_config.ha_control_plane_config.description: Configuration for HA admin cluster control plane.

network_config.ha_control_plane_config.c.description: Static IP addresses for the control plane nodes.

network_config.host_config.dns_servers.rationale: dns_servers is not security sensitive enough

The network gateway used by the VMware Admin Cluster.
The netmask used by the VMware Admin Cluster.
The node's network configurations used by the VMware Admin Cluster.
Hostname of the machine. VM's name will be used if this field is empty.
IP could be an IP address (like 1.2.3.4) or a CIDR (like 1.2.3.0/24).

platform_config.required_platform_versio.description:
The required platform version e.g. 1.13.1.
If the current platform version is lower than the target version,
the platform version will be updated to the target version.
If the target version is not installed in the platform
(bundle versions), download the target version bundle.
platform_config.required_platform_versio.rationale: required_platform_version is a sensitive field that specifies the version of the platform to be used
